text:
mike: Kicking off observability for the new eu-west-5 GPU cluster. Goal: logs, metrics, traces + a lightweight dashboard set + alert templates. Timeline: smoke validation by EOD tomorrow. Who can take ownership for the handoff?
sarah: I can own the dashboards and alerts. Quick Q: are we keeping 30d logs retention for this cluster or using a shorter window because of cost? :thinking:
jordan: For GPUs we should do 14d by default, then hot-tier 7d + cold 30d archive. Keeps cost predictable. Also need S3 lifecycle rule for archived Loki chunks.
mike: Sounds good. Deepak, any cluster/network constraints in eu-west-5 we should be aware of?
deepak: Yes — eu-west-5 doesn't have the private NAT pool like eu-west-4 yet. Need to use shared NAT gateway in the infra VPC which throttles egress bursts. Recommend staging promtail with `batch_wait: 5s` and smaller `max_batch_size`. Also need to open outbound 443 to logs-gateway.
sarah: Noted about batching. I'll set promtail config snippet to reduce spikes.
--- config snippet ---
```yaml
clients:
  - url: https://logs-gateway.redwood-internal:443/loki/api/v1/push
  batchwait: 5s
  batchsize: 1048576 # 1MB
  tenant_id: euw5-cluster-01
```
--- end snippet ---
jordan: Prometheus: keep `scrape_interval: 15s` for node/gpu_exporter, but set `sample_limit` and `max_age` to avoid blowups during bootstrap. Example alert: `RecordingRule: job:gpu_util:avg_rate5m` -> use for capacity planning.
sarah: I'll add a lightweight Grafana folder: `EUW5 / GPUs / Cluster Overview` with panels: GPU util (5m avg), pod mem, node disk, Loki error rate, traces-per-minute. Keep each panel 90s datasource resolution.
mike: What about tracing? Tempo or Jaeger collector?
deepak: Use Tempo (simple ingest via OTLP). We need to ensure the O Tel collector has a persistent queue; the NAT egress may cause transient failures so enable `retry_on_failure` and `max_retries: 5`.
--- tempo ingest example ---
```yaml
receivers:
  otlp:
    protocols:
      grpc: {}
exporters:
  loki: {}
  otlp:
    endpoint: tempo-ingest.internal:4317
service:
  pipelines:
    traces:
      receivers: [otlp]
      exporters: [otlp]
```
--- end snippet ---
anna: On cost — estimate Loki ingest: ~1.2-1.8GB/day for training logs if verbose. If we enable application debug logs during rollout that spikes to 6-8GB/day. Recommend tape-down log level and apply label sanitization. Also set per-tenant ingestion cap and billing alert.
ops-oncall: Create a budget alert: `cost > $500/day` triggers pager rota. I can add that to billing alerts.
infra-bot: [deploy-bot] dashboard stack `obs-euw5-lite` deployed to namespace `observability-euw5` at 2026-03-18T14:07:12Z :white_check_mark:
sarah: Nice. I'll validate dashboards against live metrics in the next hour. If panels are empty it's likely scrape relabel rules or service discovery mismatch.
jordan: For service discovery ensure node-exporter, gpu-exporter, kube-state-metrics have `job_name` set to `euw5-*` and `honor_labels: true`.
mike: Validation checklist (short):
- logs: promtail pushing -> Loki tenant OK (sample push + response 204)
- metrics: prometheus targets UP + scrape duration < 2s
- traces: OTLP spans visible in Tempo -> trace search returns sample traces
- dashboards: panels show >= 5m of data
- alerts: smoke alert fires in test mode and routes to #incidents or oncall
sarah: I'll run the smoke playbook: change app log level to INFO -> produce synthetic load -> expect `loki_push_success` metrics and `job:node_up` targets.
deepak: Network check: run from bastion `curl -v https://logs-gateway.redwood-internal:443/health` and `nc -vz tempo-ingest.internal 4317`. Also confirm VPC route table has correct NAT association.
anna: I'll prepare the cost summary and suggested retention policy: `logs:14d hot, 30d cold archive; metrics:90d; traces:30d` and add an ops runbook link: https://internal.runbooks/redwood/euw5-observability (hand-off doc).
ops-oncall: Once Sarah confirms smoke green, I'll flip the `observability` tag to `production` and create the incident routing rule for alerts.
mike: Who's doing final signoff?
sarah: I'll do signoff after dashboard + alerts validated. Will post final timestamp here.
anna: Ping me in the thread when you start the synthetic load, I'll watch cost dashboards.
infra-bot: [policy-bot] Note: S3 lifecycle policy required for `loki-chunks-euw5` bucket before archival. Policy flagged as missing.
sarah: Adding an item to the runbook: `S3 lifecycle + KMS key configured` before enabling cold tier.
mike: Great. Thanks everyone — let's aim to handoff to @anna for cost & compliance and to @ops-oncall for alerting routing by EOD tomorrow.
ops-oncall: ack. I'll be on standby at 18:00 UTC for routing flip.
[sarah pinned a message to this thread]: smoke validation checklist uploaded to https://internal.docs/obs-euw5-smoke
anna: final note — if ingestion spikes, autoscaling policy for `loki-ingester` will add 2 replicas up to 6; keep the horizontal autoscaler cooldown at 3m to avoid thrash.
mike: Closing loop — will wait for Sarah's green and then create the handoff ticket to `#release-handoffs`. Thanks!
